verdict.rationale: Docs mention a 'Your VPC' deployment option for the commercial Zep product (zep-docs-17) and the underlying Graphiti knowledge-graph engine is explicitly open-source and runnable locally (zep-docs-15, zep-gh-1/2/3), but the primary quick-start flow is cloud-only (pip install zep-cloud, cloud sign-up) with no self-hosting guide, Docker image, or on-prem install instructions for the full core product. Missing for 10: an explicit self-host/on-prem deployment guide for the main Zep service, license/edition details for self-hosting, and community confirmation that self-hosting works in practice.
